name: Distant Accuracy
body:
School transmutation [metal, wood]; Level legendary ninja 1, magus 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Targets one ranged weapon, or one thrown weapon/level
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You enchant the target weapon(s) with the ability to strike creatures far beyond its normal range, doubling its range increment. If cast on a ranged weapon, this effect applies to all ammunition shot from it. Any creature wielding these weapons gains this benefit.
